 1937.22BA.od  2  Penal Code is seized with the Hon'ble Supreme  Court.
The Police have seized the alleged gutka.
Nothing is to be recovered from the applicants.

However, the learned APP submits that the other  co-accused are repeatedly involved in the same  crime and few are absconding.
 3. Perused the papers.
Whether section 328  of the I.P. Code would apply is the question in  this case, however, it has been seized with the  Hon'ble Supreme Court.
Prima facie, it appears  that nothing is to be recovered from t  applicants.
However, the apprehension of t  prosecution can be guarded by imposing certain  conditions.

In that view of the matter, 
 application deserves to be allowed.

Hence, the  following order :-
 ORDER (i) The application is allowed.

ii) Applicants be released on bail, on furnishing PB and SB of Rs.50,000/- each with one solvent surety of the like amount, in C.R.No.0379 of 2022 registered with the MIDC Cidco Police Station,
District Aurangabad, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code and section 59 of the Foods Safety and Standards Act, 2006, on the conditions that they shall attend the Police Station on every Monday between 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. till 1937.22BA.odt filing the charge-sheet, and shall not involve in the similar crime (S.G.
